item.title: Demand for student teacher stipends outstrips supply as Shapiro proposes boosting program
item.description: HARRISBURG — A stipend aimed at getting more student teachers into Pennsylvania schools and easing the commonwealth’s educator shortage is working, education advocates and experts say. But demand for the $30 million program is outstripping available funds. In his latest budget proposal, Gov. item.title: Josh Shapiro has a 15-to-1 fundraising advantage over Republican Stacy Garrity
item.description: HARRISBURG — Democratic Gov. Josh Shapiro outraised Republican Stacy Garrity by more than 15-to-1 in 2025. And the race is just getting started. Shapiro privately told top donors in January that he aims to raise anywhere from $90 to $100 million for his reelection. Such a total would break a state record that Shapiro himself set when he raised $68 million for his gubernatorial race in 2022. item.description: NEW YORK —Two men who brought explosives to a protest outside New York City's mayoral mansion said they were inspired by the Islamic State extremist group, a court complaint said. item.description: PAOLI — A Pennsylvania State Police trooper was shot and killed by a suspect whom he had pulled over in a traffic stop Sunday night, authorities said. Cpl.
